values.content:
=You are a sales pipeline manager for {{ $env.BUSINESS_NAME }}.

Create a prioritised daily chase list for {{ $json.review_date }}.

ALL ACTIVE LEADS:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.active_leads, null, 2) }}

STALE LEADS (no contact in 7+ days):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.stale_leads, null, 2) }}

Generate a concise WhatsApp-formatted chase list that:
1. Lists the top 5 leads to contact TODAY in priority order
2. For each: name, service interested in, days since last contact, suggested action
3. Flags any hot leads or leads with upcoming next_action_date
4. Ends with a one-line pipeline health summary

Format for WhatsApp (use emojis, line breaks, keep total under 600 chars):

📋 Chase List — [date]

🔥 Priority contacts today:
1. [Name] — [service] — [X days stale] — [action]
2. ...

💡 Pipeline: [health summary]

Return only the WhatsApp message text, no JSON wrapper.

meta.description: Two-branch CRM workflow. Branch A: Status Updater webhook — updates CRM sheet, triggers invoice on win, sends congratulations WhatsApp, and schedules 14-day re-engagement email on loss. Branch B: Daily 8am pipeline review — Claude generates a prioritised chase list of stale leads and sends via WhatsApp.
